steps.text:
Materials Needed: Colored tiles, three each of five different colors.

Overview: Working with nonsense words that have three sounds (VCC). Vowel-Consonant-Consonant. The last two consonants are Ending Consonant Blends. Use ONLY short vowel sounds.
Now you're going to break apart a slightly tougher word. Ready? The first word is IZM.
Expected: IZM
Now say it again ... very slowly.
Expected: /iiii/-/zzzz/-/mmmm/
How many sounds did you hear?
Expected: 3
So pull down 3 tiles.
Touch-and-say each sound.
Student touches the first tile and says /i/, touches the second tile and says /z/, then touches the third tile and says /m/.
Now wash those tiles off.
Dictate the remaining words one by one: USK, IKT, OND, ILT, UNT. Use Extra Practice words if student struggles.
Now you'll break a word then I'll change a sound. Ready? The first word is IST.
Expected: IST
Say it again ... very slowly.
Expected: /iiii/-/ssss/-/t/
Pull down the tiles.
Touch-and-say.
Student touches first tile and says /i/, touches second tile and says /s/, touches third tile and says /t/.
Now watch carefully. I'm going to change this sound to /o/.
To figure out the new word, touch-and-say the sounds.
Student touches first tile and says /o/, touches second tile and says /s/, touches third tile and says /t/.
Slowly blend those sounds into a word.
Expected: /oooo/-/ssss/-/t/
Now say it fast like a word.
Expected: OST
Here's the new step. Watch carefully. I'm going to take out this tile.
Touch-and-say the sounds that are left.
Student touches first tile and says /o/, touches second tile and says /s/.
Slowly blend.
Expected: /oooo/-/ssss/
Now say it fast like a word.
Expected: OS
Great. Go ahead and wash off those tiles.
Dictate the remaining sets: IMP -> ISP -> IP, INT -> UNT -> UN, ILSH -> ILT -> IL, UPT -> UKT -> UT.
Now we're going to compare two words. The first word is INT.
Expected: INT
Say it slowly.
Expected: /iiii/-/nnnn/-/t/
Touch-and-say using the first row.
Student touches first tile and says /i/, touches second tile and says /n/, touches the third tile and says /t/.
Good. The second word is UNT.
Expected: UNT
Slowly.
Expected: /uuuu/-/nnnn/-/t/
Touch-and-say using the second row.
Student touches first tile and says /u/, touches second tile and says /n/, touches third tile and says /t/ in the second row.
Here's the tough part. Touch-and-say until you find the sound that's different. INT. UNT.
Expected: The first sounds are different.
Good listening. So go ahead and change the first tile in the new word ... to show that it's different.
Student changes the FIRST tile in the second row.
That's perfect. Now go ahead and wash off those tiles.
Dictate the remaining sets: ILK & ILM, UPT & OPT, UST & UNT, IND & OND.
